sn38.1:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā sāriputto magadhesu viharati nālagāmake.
sn38.1:1.2: atha kho jambukhādako paribbājako yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn38.1:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho jambukhādako paribbājako āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca:
sn38.1:2.3: yo kho āvuso rāgakkhayo dosakkhayo mohakkhayo
sn38.1:2.5: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.1:2.6: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.1:2.7: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.1:2.8: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.1:2.9: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
sn38.1:2.10: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāyāti.
sn38.1:2.11: bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
